title: Bulkhead Pattern
subtitle: Give each dependency its own compartment so one hung call cannot sink the whole service
motto: Let one compartment flood, and keep the ship afloat
keyInsight: Separate pools turn a hung dependency from a service-wide outage into a local one, but idle capacity in one pool cannot help another, so each pool has to be sized.

decisions.title: Measure the healthy dependencies' failures
decisions.description: The metric that matters is how many requests to healthy dependencies fail, since that is the harm a shared pool spreads and a bulkhead contains.
decisions.alternatives: Counting total failures alone would hide that the bulkhead's remaining failures all belong to the broken dependency.

decisions.title: Fail the bulkhead with a spike
decisions.description: The failure frame sends a healthy dependency too much traffic to show a tight compartment rejecting requests while other pools sit idle.
decisions.alternatives: Showing only the hung-dependency win would present isolation as free.
